{
  "score": 7,
  "findings": [
    {
      "file": "tests/unit/platform-probe-test.sh",
      "category": "coverage",
      "severity": "medium",
      "message": "DSPRB-3 asserts `_ZB_STAT_MODE_CMD` contains `-c` unconditionally, but on a macOS host (where `stat -c '%a'` fails) the probe correctly sets the BSD `-f` form; the test has no host guard and would produce a false failure on BSD.",
      "quote": "assert_contains \"[DSPRB-3] the stat probe encodes the GNU -c form (not BSD -f)\" \\",
      "introduced": true,
      "fix": "test"
    },
    {
      "file": "tests/unit/platform-probe-test.sh",
      "category": "logic",
      "severity": "medium",
      "message": "`_actual_mode` is computed unconditionally with `stat -c '%a'`; on a macOS host where BSD stat ignores `-c`, `_actual_mode` is silently empty, making the subsequent `assert_eq` compare empty string to `_dsprb2_mode` and fail even when the implementation is correct on BSD.",
      "quote": "_actual_mode=\"$(\"$_real_stat\" -c '%a' \"$_f2\")\"",
      "introduced": true,
      "fix": "test"
    },
    {
      "file": "tests/e2e/fork-budget-test.sh",
      "category": "coverage",
      "severity": "medium",
      "message": "The DSBUD-2 assertion checks whether `FAIL > 0` is `0` at that point in the script, which is tautological — it passes whenever every prior assertion passed, adding no independent verification that the probe specifically avoids extra `stat` processes in the fork budget.",
      "quote": "assert_eq \"[DSBUD-2] tests/e2e/fork-budget-test.sh passes (exits 0) after the probe change\" \\",
      "introduced": true,
      "fix": "test"
    }
  ]
}
